12:55.race_name: bet365 Scottish Supreme Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Solid record reads 21121; the ratings suggest he's set for another top-two finish
runners.name: Captain Hugo
runners.spotlight: Solid record (bumpers/hurdles) reads 21121, all wins on good/good to soft, latest at Haydock (1m7f) where he was in a share of the lead when left clear at the final flight; the ratings suggest he's set for another top-two finish.

runners.comment: Record of 4-5 overall and 2-2 over hurdles; impressive last time; clear top on ratings
runners.name: Mossy Fen Road
runners.spotlight: Record of 4-5 overall and 2-2 since switched to hurdles; jumped slickly on his way to an impressive success from the front at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) most recently; clear top on ratings and again should be difficult to peg back.

runners.comment: Faced a straightforward task last time; this is a stiffer assignment
runners.name: Onlyforfrankie
runners.spotlight: Recorded a useful bumper RPR on final Irish start but has failed to reproduce the form for new yard, last time facing a straightforward task when 1-3 odds at Taunton (2m, good) in second hurdles run; this is a stiffer assignment.

runners.comment: May still do better but faces a difficult task on ratings as things stand
runners.name: Smoke Trail
runners.spotlight: Lived up to market expectations (outsider of three) at Haydock when bidding to follow up his Kelso success; still possibly open to progress, having raced just twice under rules, but faces a difficult task on ratings as things stand.

13:25.race_name: bet365 Frodon Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won at the Galway festival on chase debut; disappointing last time but not written off
runners.name: Intense Approach
runners.spotlight: Irish 7yo whose overall record of 8-17 includes a success at the Galway festival (2m6f, good) on chase debut; disappointing at Cheltenham in only subsequent start but may still have more to offer in this sphere; effective when fresh.

runners.comment: Form dipped last time but otherwise a largely progressive sort; may well rebound
runners.name: Go West
runners.spotlight: Form dipped last time (unable to lead) but otherwise a largely progressive sort; penultimate effort has been boosted by the winner since; may well rebound, especially if he returns to dominating (all wins from the front); shortlisted.

runners.comment: Retains potential in this sphere, being a dual Listed winner (bumper/hurdle); big player
runners.name: Queens Gamble
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly at about 2m but is likely to stay 2m4f on this course; seemed to need her only outing this season (chase debut) and retains potential in this sphere, being a dual Listed winner (bumper/hurdle); major contender.

runners.comment: Ran promisingly at Ayr switched to chasing last time and looks open to progress; respected
runners.name: Dedicated Hero
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful over hurdles, albeit registered his Grade 2 success in a substandard race for the level; ran promisingly at Ayr (2m) switched to chasing last time and looks open to progress in this sphere; return to 2m4f is worth a go; respected.

runners.comment: Let down by his jumping on chase/seasonal debut; needs to find greater fluency
runners.name: Elysian Knight
runners.spotlight: Two wins as a novice hurdler last term; disappointing favourite, let down by his jumping, in novice handicap chase at Chepstow in sole start this season; chance partly depends on whether he finds greater fluency.

runners.comment: Not solid on hurdles form this term; the only runner who lacks chasing experience
runners.name: Bold Light
runners.spotlight: Not particularly solid on hurdles form this term and he's the only contestant who lacks chasing experience; showed promise in one of his Irish point attempts but that was nearly five years ago; others preferred.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras De Peyre
runners.comment: Lacks recent match practice and needs to prove he retains peak ability
runners.name: Parisencore
runners.owner: Mrs I C Sellars And Miss D C Sellars
runners.spotlight: On a competitive mark on best form but lacks recent match practice and needs to prove he retains peak ability; below-par fourth in two starts last year, both in the spring; absent since.

runners.comment: Only 1-12 over fences but returns to handicap level off a handy mark
runners.name: Aeros Luck
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish novice chaser who is only 1-12 in this sphere but has a workable mark; 0-3 for new yard, albeit faced a stiff task at the weights last time; return to handicap level gives him a better chance.

runners.comment: Consistent but gets virtually no help from the assessor; fourth at Sandown yesterday
runners.name: Denemethy
runners.spotlight: Consistent since sole chase success, most recently fourth at Sandown (1m7f) yesterday; getting virtually no help from the assessor and may struggle to land this prize off current mark but seems likely to give his running.

runners.comment: Record of 3-6 since handicapping and 2-2 since switched to fences; respected
runners.name: Koukeo
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-6 since handicapping and 2-2 since switched to fences; collared a solid rival close home at Haydock (2m, good to soft) most recently, justifying favouritism; respected with further improvement on the cards.

runners.comment: 0-4 for new yard but posted a resurgent effort at Musselburgh yesterday
runners.name: Bleu dEnfer
runners.spotlight: On last winning mark; 0-4 for new yard but posted a resurgent effort in the Scottish Champion Chase at Musselburgh (2m4f) yesterday; drops back to 2m for first time in a year.

runners.comment: Something to prove back up in grade; has done all his winning in Class 4
runners.name: Chapel Green
runners.spotlight: Bad early mistake contributed to a poor effort when last seen; scored at Kelso in only other start this term but has something to prove back up in grade, having done all his winning in Class 4.

runners.comment: Novice chaser who remains of interest, with further progress still possible
runners.name: Pure Carbon
runners.spotlight: Unexposed novice chaser whose win at Huntingdon (2m, good) built on a promising reappearance effort; unseated rider in the early stages at Ludlow since; remains of interest, with further progress still possible.

14:30.race_name: Position Payout A bet365 Handicap Hurdle (Go North Cab On Target Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Irish maiden who has been absent since November 2024; market can guide
runners.name: Charlies Dilemma
runners.spotlight: Irish maiden who has plenty of placed form but lacks recent match practice, having been absent since November 2024; market may prove best guide to expectations; handicap debut.

runners.comment: Largely consistent but needs progress to land this competitive handicap
runners.name: How About No
runners.spotlight: Has largely consistent form but needs progress to land this competitive handicap and double his hurdles tally; steps back up in distance (placed over 2m4f in Ireland).

runners.comment: Still unexposed; new trip is worth exploring; interesting handicap debutant
runners.name: The Hatchet
runners.spotlight: Two attempts over hurdles, both over 2m, comprise a win at Perth and rallying third at Ayr; still unexposed and, with this longer trip worth exploring, looks an interesting handicap debutant.

runners.comment: Veteran who remains consistent; getting no respite from the assessor but looks solid
runners.name: Summergrounds
runners.spotlight: Veteran who remains consistent and is threatening to add to his tally, having finished second in last three starts; getting no respite from the assessor but again holds a solid chance.

runners.breeder: E A R L Elevage Des Loges
runners.comment: Returns to hurdles with a doubt over his current form
runners.name: Bois Guillbert
runners.spotlight: Returns to hurdles off a workable mark but, judged on his chase efforts this term, has a doubt over current form.

runners.comment: Interesting on debut for Adrian Keatley, who has started 2026 with a bang
runners.name: Newtown Rambler
runners.spotlight: Best form for Henry de Bromhead when winning once over hurdles and placed twice over fences; interesting returned to this sphere on debut for Adrian Keatley, who has started 2026 with a bang.

runners.comment: Solid second in C&D maiden hurdle last time; strong contender on handicap debut
runners.name: The G Wizard
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who has shown consistent promise; solid second, behind a subsequent scorer, in C&D maiden hurdle (good to soft) most recently; strong contender off an unaltered mark on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Losing sequence is mounting up; not the percentage call
runners.name: Young Merlin
runners.spotlight: Has several pieces of placed form (Flat/hurdles) for current yard but his losing sequence is mounting up; not the percentage call in this competitive affair.

runners.comment: 2-2 in handicaps, both wins over 1m7f at Musselburgh, latest in ready style yesterday
runners.name: Magna Victor
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who is 2-2 since handicapping, both wins over 1m7f on good to soft ground at Musselburgh, latest in ready fashion yesterday; open to further progress, assuming he stays this new trip.

runners.comment: Chase wins at Musselburgh the last twice; only 1-22 over hurdles
runners.name: OFaolains Glory
runners.spotlight: Wins a Musselburgh (2m4f) the last twice took her chase record to 3-10; only 1-22 over hurdles and has to deal with a career-high mark back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Has shown career-best form since wearing cheekpieces; enters calculations
runners.name: Speiriuil
runners.spotlight: Has shown career-best form since wearing cheekpieces, finishing second over C&D then going one better at Kelso (2m2f, good to soft); may have more to offer in the retained headgear; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Maiden; gives the impression he may improve for this first crack at 2m4f
runners.name: Rememberthename
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who isn't totally solid on his form (2m6f/3m) for new stable but gives the impression he may improve for this first crack at 2m4f.

runners.comment: Irish maiden; form dipped last time; no certainty to improve at his age
runners.name: The Toothpicker
runners.spotlight: One of two Irish maidens in the field; has posted a couple of encouraging efforts since returning from long absence but form dipped last time; no certainty to improve, being a 9yo.

15:05.race_name: bet365 Edinburgh National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Disappointed in Welsh National but breezed home 11l in front at Ascot (3m5f) time before
runners.name: Rock My Way
runners.spotlight: Only 2-12 over fences but he was second in the 3m6f NH Chase at Cheltenham (good to soft; has won on soft) last March and breezed home 11l in front  at Ascot (3m5f, good) in November; disappointing in the Welsh National (rather getting squeezed out at the start didn't help) but he has a big shout if reverting to the Ascot level of performance.

runners.comment: Kelso wins in March (3m2f) and November (2m7f) were the only times he ran well last year
runners.name: Cadell
runners.spotlight: Won at Kelso (3m2f) last March and first-time blinkers (retained since) prompted a career-best performance when he scored under Jack Power at same track (2m7f) in November; however, those are the only times he ran well last year, while he was pulled up in this race and also when trying 4m on soft ground at Kelso on latest outing; others look more solid.

runners.comment: Player on last season's form but needs a revival; new visor replaces cheekpieces
runners.name: Transmission
runners.spotlight: Cheltenham regular over fences and competitive off slightly higher marks than this last season, never-nearer fifth in the NH Chase when shaping as if he stayed 3m6f; that's not been the case this campaign and although a good deal closer at Ascot last time, he was still only eighth of ten finishers; needs to build markedly on that in new visor, replacing cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Borders National win at Kelso (4m, soft) in December was best form for nearly two years
runners.name: Grozni
runners.spotlight: With James Owen for 18 months (Scottish National fourth in April) before joining this yard; Borders National win at Kelso (4m, soft) in December was his best form for nearly two years and he kept jumping to his right, so reverting to a right-handed track today may well help; back up 5lb but shortlisted.

runners.comment: Dominated closing stages of this race in 2023 and 2025; just 4lb higher than 2025; wind op
runners.name: Magna Sam
runners.spotlight: Dominated the closing stages of this race in 2023 and 2025, both on good to soft; he's now a 12yo but just 4lb higher than 12 months ago and therefore well handicapped, having failed to achieve much in his three starts since but he made a respiratory noise on latest and had a wind operation (his second) 23 days ago; back up in trip, with this race surely having been his aim.

runners.comment: 6lb lower than when 2nd in this last year; shaped as if in need of race on reappearance
runners.name: Bodhisattva
runners.spotlight: Just one win from his 18 chase starts and his jumping can be an issue; however, he's 6lb lower than when second in this race last year and shaped as if in need of the race when 40-1 in the Borders National on reappearance; should be more interesting again this time and has place claims at least.

runners.comment: Third chase start when winning in good style here (2m7f, good to soft) six weeks ago
runners.name: Forged Well
runners.owner: Mrs Suzy Brown & Peter R Brown
runners.spotlight: Switched to chasing this season; still in front when clouting two out at Ayr (3m, soft) on second attempt, before coming down at the last; no such mishaps at this track (2m7f, good to soft) six weeks ago and he won in good style; 7lb higher today (with 5lb claimer recruited, though) and this trip is a big step into the unknown but he ran on strongly in that latest start; unexposed and has to be considered seriously.

runners.comment: Runaway winner of this in 2024 off 6lb higher; disappointing since and can't be trusted
runners.name: Inis Oirr
runners.spotlight: Runaway winner of this prize in 2024 (good to soft) off 6lb higher when visored for the first time but, in various headgear, he's not recaptured that form; unseated at the first when favourite in this race last year and reappearance (beaten a neck at Carlisle) is the only time he's been competitive this term; can't be trusted.

15:40.race_name: Pertemps Network Group Handicap Hurdle (Pertemps Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Second attempt back hurdling; thrown in if he can even remotely get his act together
runners.name: Ahoy Senor
runners.spotlight: Very much the class act in this field but he's become hugely frustrating as a chaser and tailed off (after making the running) when he reverted to hurdles in a Grade 2 at Newbury on latest outing; thrown in if he can even remotely get his act together.

runners.comment: Ran respectably latest on second chase attempt at about 3m; first hurdle race since 2024
runners.name: Anyway
runners.spotlight: Rallied well when 125-1 second in a 2m4f handicap chase at last year's Cheltenham Festival; he's since won a beginners chase in Ireland and ran respectably at Cheltenham last time on his second attempt at about 3m; needs to build on that in today's first hurdle race since August 2024.

runners.comment: Won in big field at Uttoxeter (1lb higher today) last March; tailed off both starts since
runners.name: Red Risk
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xliv & A&j Ryan
runners.spotlight: Veteran who won in a big field at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good to soft; 1lb higher today) last March; tailed off both starts since (Freddie Keighley on board last time) but with nearly eight months off in between and his trainer (also runs Sonigino) is always one to note here.

runners.comment: Second in the Lanzarote at Kempton (2m5f) latest; Aintree last April showed he stays 3m
runners.name: Double Powerful
runners.spotlight: Back hurdling for last two starts, coming a cropper again on first occasion (hampered) but second of 15 from the back in the Lanzarote at Kempton (2m5f, good; has won on soft/heavy) nine days later; progressive when he does complete and he showed at Aintree last April that he stays 3m; player.

runners.comment: Unraced beyond 2m4f under rules; hooded for the first time; back with his initial trainer
runners.name: Encanto Bruno
runners.spotlight: Career peak was in October 2023 on first start for Gavin Cromwell and he was well beaten when runner-up over fences last April and June; unraced beyond 2m4f under rules and now wears a hood for the first time; back with John McConnell, with whom he started his career.

runners.comment: Didn't get best of runs at Sandown (2m4f) latest but kept on well to be close third of ten
runners.name: Sonigino
runners.owner: Sir A Ferguson G Mason L Hales The Late J Hales
runners.spotlight: Ended 2023-24 season in poor form and had 596 days off before this term; Sandown (2m4f) on latest start was promising, though, as he didn't get the best of runs but kept on well to be a close third of ten; unraced beyond 2m5f but that latest performance makes him interesting.

runners.comment: Heavy defeats in hot races first two runs this winter
runners.name: I Love My Baie
runners.spotlight: Three wins at 2m4f and placed once in first six attempts over about 3m; heavy defeats in hot races on first two starts this winter and his form last spring does not look good enough either.

runners.comment: Good placed efforts at about 3m on his last four outings and fully effective at this track
runners.name: Lihyan
runners.spotlight: Ridden last eight starts by William Maggs; rarely seen on soft but runner-up twice on it early in 2024; six-time winner, most recently in May; good placed efforts at about 3m on his last four outings and fully effective at this track, so he again has each-way prospects.

runners.comment: Chase career has gone off the rails; back hurdling today for first time since May 2024
runners.name: Beachcomber
runners.spotlight: Won well off this mark at Kempton (3m) at Christmas 2024 but that chase career has gone off the rails, which sees him back hurdling today for first time since May 2024; mixed messages.

runners.comment: Fourth in this last year and also ran creditably on first two (of three) starts this term
runners.name: Idem
runners.spotlight: Fourth in this race last year and also ran creditably on first two starts this season; needs to bounce back from a poor show at Haydock six weeks ago and even then a career best is probably needed to win this.

runners.comment: 1-12 in handicaps; attempted this sort of trip only once, in his novice days
runners.name: Florida Dreams
runners.spotlight: Has won only one (October 2024) of his 12 handicaps but twice went close over 2m4f to start this season and has run respectably on both outings since; attempted this sort of trip only once, in his novice days, and it needs to help for him to break the deadlock.

runners.comment: Stuck to his task well over an extended 2m5f at Ascot last time; 2lb out of the handicap
runners.name: The Gray Ghost
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden last January and mostly ran with credit in handicaps but he needs to find extra on this first venture beyond an extended 2m5f; favourite, stuck to his task well (after final-flight mistake) over that trip at Ascot latest on second run since wind surgery; 2lb out of handicap but considered.

runners.comment: 1st and 2nd in his first two handicaps over this sort of trip;  3lb out of the handicap
runners.name: Highland Fashion
runners.spotlight: Relished the step up in trip to make a winning handicap debut at Newcastle (3m, good to soft) in November; good second at Ayr (3m, soft) one month ago but position 3lb out of the handicap demands more from him today; claiming rider is recruited.

runners.comment: Front-runner; this new trip asks a big question; he's also 5lb out of the handicap
runners.name: Bel Amigo
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; won three novice hurdles at Carlisle (2m1f/2m3f, good to soft/good) last spring; placed in three of his five handicaps since but the last two instances were over just 2m1f and 2m, so this new trip asks a big question; he's also 5lb out of the handicap.

runners.comment: Open to progress now handicapping; second start for new yard
runners.name: Whiskey On Ice
runners.spotlight: Made the frame a few times on good ground for previous yard; heavy going provides an excuse for lesser effort on debut for new stable; open to progress now handicapping.

runners.comment: Has to deal with a career-high mark on this return to hurdles
runners.name: Benefit Ben
runners.owner: D & D Armstrong Ltd & L Westwood
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-4 this term; flopped last time when bidding for a Musselburgh chase double; effective over hurdles but has to deal with a career-high mark back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Irish maiden who has shown positive signs since wearing cheekpieces; interesting
runners.name: Take Chance
runners.spotlight: Irish maiden who has shown positive signs since wearing cheekpieces, making the frame over 3m at Down Royal and Punchestown; may take another step forward in the retained headgear; interesting.

runners.breeder: Mme Philippe Morruzzi & Mr Philippe Morr
runners.comment: Couple of encouraging efforts since handicapping, good second at Carlisle latest
runners.name: Dearkeithandkaty
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; has posted a couple of encouraging efforts over 2m4f since handicapping, good second at Carlisle (soft) latest; may take another step forward upped further in distance; respected.

runners.comment: Might have won C&D contest last time but for edging left; in the mix
runners.name: Lizzie Luna
runners.spotlight: Gained sole win at Musselburgh (2m4f) and nearly doubled her tally, beaten a whisker by Reflection Of You having edged left, in C&D event (good to soft; first 3m attempt) latest start; in the mix, especially if keeping a straighter line.

runners.comment: Started the campaign in good form; inconsistent since
runners.name: Evenwood Sonofagun
runners.owner: Mrs D Chapman & Mrs E Quinlan
runners.spotlight: Started the campaign in good form, including two wins at Cartmel, but has lacked consistency since; doesn't look as if he's about to take advantage of a handy mark.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs Stephen OFlynn & John M Flynn
runners.comment: Poor claims on his form for new stable
runners.name: Dunnet Head
runners.spotlight: Defied a higher mark for previous yard but holds poor claims on his form (hurdles/fences) for new stable; enough to prove back up in distance.

runners.breeder: Mrs S C Welch & Mr A King
runners.comment: Suited by the return to hurdles in C&D event last time; may remain competitive
runners.name: Reflection Of You
runners.spotlight: Had jumping issues during her chase spell and proved suited by the return to hurdles in C&D contest (good to soft) last time, just holding on from Lizzie Luna who might have won but for coming off a true line; may remain competitive.

12:47.race_name: Market Rasen Racecourse Caravan Site Conditional Jockeys' Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Latest qualifying run was encouraging; upped from 2m for this handicap debut
runners.name: Glenmuick
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on first two hurdling starts but his fifth at Uttoxeter (2m, heavy) in December was much more encouraging; upped in trip and fitted with tongue-tie for this handicap debut; should have more improvement to come.

runners.comment: Lowly rated Flat maiden who showed only glimmers of promise in 2m maiden/novice hurdles
runners.name: Saachi
runners.spotlight: Lowly rated Flat maiden who showed only glimmers of promise in three 2m maiden/novice hurdles in the autumn; upped in trip for this handicap hurdle debut; needs to take a big step forward.

runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles but ran pretty well when fourth on last three outings (twice over C&D)
runners.name: Wind Your Neck In
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles but ran pretty well when fourth on last three appearances (twice over C&D); continues to slip down the weights and should cope if the ground turns soft; good chance.

runners.comment: Three-time chase winner; below form last time but still considered on this rare hurdle run
runners.name: We Got Your Back
runners.spotlight: Three-time chase winner, most recently at Hexham (1m7f, good; also suited by soft) in October; below form on latest outing two months ago and remains on fairly tough mark for this rare hurdle run but still makes more appeal than some of these.

runners.comment: Unseated rider at second flight when 80-1 for recent handicap debut
runners.name: De Deli Counter
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider at second flight when 80-1 for recent handicap debut (first-time visor); remains very unexposed but could be considered only if much stronger in the betting today.

runners.comment: Unplaced all six hurdling starts; needs new tongue-tie to make a big difference
runners.name: River Rider
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two 2m3f handicaps towards end of last year and has now been unplaced in all six hurdle starts; needs first-time tongue-tie to make a big difference.

runners.comment: No threat in novice company over hurdles but ought to be more competitive in this handicap
runners.name: Cooler Than Me
runners.spotlight: Former pointer who returned from long absence with two low-key 2m hurdle runs for new stable this winter; has much better chance to get competitive on this handicap debut, though, and the move back up in trip ought to suit; sports first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Showed no significant promise when a big-priced outsider for three novice/maiden hurdles
runners.name: Kit The Christian
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise when a big-priced outsider for three novice/maiden hurdles (2m-2m3f, good/good to soft) last year; needs help from the first-time cheekpieces on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: 66-1 second at Fakenham two runs ago but far too inconsistent to rely upon
runners.name: Annie Nail
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner; returned to form with 66-1 second over hurdles at Fakenham (2m7f, soft) in December but was safely held in a 2m5f chase there last month and is far too inconsistent to rely upon.

13:17.race_name: Book Into Our Altior's Resturant Today EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Montaigu
runners.comment: Gained hard-fought win at Leicester (1m7f) in December; this longer trip ought to suit
runners.name: Roi Du Risk
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who opened hurdling account at second attempt, with hard-fought success at Leicester (1m7f, soft) in December; probably needs a better performance to overcome a penalty here but his pedigree suggests the longer trip will suit.

runners.comment: Close second on both hurdling starts at Lingfield (2m3f/2m); likely contender again here
runners.name: Cinquenta
runners.spotlight: Third in all three bumpers last season and close second in two Lingfield hurdles this term (2m3f/2m, good to soft); that hurdling form puts him right in the thick of things here, and he probably still has potential.

runners.comment: Posed no threat on first three hurdling starts (1m7f-2m1f)
runners.name: Gaelic Glow
runners.spotlight: Posed no threat on first three hurdling starts (1m7f-2m1f), with last two runs attracting stewards' attention; upped in trip here; will probably be of greater interest if/when the handicapper sees fit to give him a mark.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; launched rules career with two good runs at Ffos Las; big player here
runners.name: Gee Force Flyer
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; placed behind useful rival on rules debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) in October and not discredited when clear second of four behind next-time-out winner there three weeks later; major player.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; shaped well before weakening into fourth on rules debut at Hereford
runners.name: Jukebox King
runners.spotlight: Changed hands after winning Irish point debut just over a year ago (yielding ground) and shaped well before weakening into fourth on rules debut at Hereford (2m3f, good to soft; tongue tied) in December, form that has worked out pretty well since; has possibilities if that outing brought him on.

runners.comment: Fourth in Hereford bumper last month but made a disappointing hurdle debut on Friday
runners.name: Roi Du Roume
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner in November (yielding ground); made a quite promising rules debut when fourth in soft-ground Hereford bumper last month but his hurdling debut at Ffos Las (2m, heavy) on Friday was very disappointing.

runners.comment: Not beaten far in two useful Ascot maidens; each-way claims at least in this easier race
runners.name: Seamoon Story
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on Irish point debut last April and not beaten far in two useful Ascot maiden hurdles towards end of 2025, latterly when fifth of 12 over 2m5f (soft); holds each-way claims at least in this easier race.

runners.comment: Tailed off (albeit on heavy ground) when 100-1 for debut at Ffos Las (2m4f) on Friday
runners.name: Wings Of Arion
runners.spotlight: Tailed off (albeit on heavy ground) when 100-1 for debut at Ffos Las (2m4f) on Friday.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten on her first two hurdling starts (both 2m) and can't be recommended here
runners.name: Mcflo
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on her first two hurdling starts (both 2m) and can't be recommended here.

13:47.race_name: Easter Sunday Racing Ft. Classic Vehicle Rally Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Stayed on for third over 2m3f on chase debut; back up in trip today; big player
runners.name: Grandads Cap
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who made promising chase debut at Catterick (2m3f, good) just after Christmas, staying on well for third; moves back up in trip here and has plenty of scope for improvement; must be considered.

runners.comment: Pulled up when 66-1 for handicap chase in December; headgear added today
runners.name: Pulse Of Camelot
runners.spotlight: Placed in Irish hunter chase (2m5f, heavy) in early 2024 but struggled in maiden/novice hurdles for new stable last season and was pulled up when 66-1 for 2m4f handicap chase in December; upped in trip with tongue-tie/cheekpieces added today; leap of faith required to support him.

runners.comment: One of two to pull well clear of the others when second over C&D on Boxing Day; respected
runners.name: Alltalknoaction
runners.spotlight: 0-10 under all codes but was one of two to pull well clear of the others when close second over C&D (good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) on Boxing Day; 4lb higher now but an obvious contender if in similar form.

runners.comment: 0-10 over fences but returned from long absence with two good seconds in the autumn
runners.name: Frankie Faulkner
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over fences but returned from long absence with two good seconds in the autumn, the latter at Southwell (3m, good to soft; cheekpieces refitted); remains well handicapped on older form and today's slightly slower ground ought to suit; a possible.

runners.comment: Went close on seasonal debut and bumped into a big improver last time
runners.name: Try The Money
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over fences and 0-16 overall but went close on seasonal debut at Ffos Las (3m, soft) in November and bumped into a big improver when well-held second at Uttoxeter (3m, heavy) in December; this right-handed track may not be ideal (jumped left at Taunton last season) but, otherwise, his claims are pretty solid; cheekpieces removed after one use.

runners.comment: 1-16 over hurdles; struggled on chasing debut at Ffos Las on Friday
runners.name: Lady Harriett
runners.spotlight: 1-16 over hurdles, the win gained at Ffos Las (2m4f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) last season; stayed on for third in first-time blinkers at Fakenham (2m7f soft) in December but struggled on chasing debut at Ffos Las on Friday.

runners.comment: Pulled up in her first two chases and arrives here with a lot to prove
runners.name: Worth The Walk
runners.spotlight: Won heavy-ground Irish point in February 2024 but pulled up in her first two chases (both on heavy ground in December) and arrives here with a lot to prove.

14:20.race_name: Weatherbys Cheltenham Festival Betting Guide Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Stayers Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Six hurdle wins; arrives here after two heavy defeats but has slipped to a tempting mark
runners.name: Secret Trix
runners.spotlight: Six-time hurdle winner (2m7f-3m, good-soft); arrives here after two heavy defeats but has slipped to a very tempting mark and will appreciate this ease in grade; dangerous to ignore.

runners.comment: 2-6 over hurdles; ran big race from the front when clear second at Warwick last time
runners.name: Sunshine Diamond
runners.spotlight: 2-6 over hurdles; ran big race from the front when clear second at Warwick (3m2f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve and was nudged up only 1lb for that; leading contender.

runners.comment: Runner-up on second of three stable starts but quickly back in the doldrums last time
runners.name: Bridge North
runners.spotlight: Bounced back from disappointing stable debut when second in first-time cheekpieces at Southwell (3m, good to soft) in December but was quickly back in the doldrums on next outing and has become hard to predict.

runners.comment: Well handicapped on old form but needs a revival
runners.name: Ramo
runners.owner: C B Compton & L Di Franco
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form but didn't fire during light campaign last season and was tailed off when reappearing in December; revival needed.

runners.comment: Pulled up over fences last month but reverts to hurdling on a good mark
runners.name: Gold In The Rivers
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on seasonal/chase debut at Lingfield (2m4f, good; wore cheekpieces) in November but was pulled up in first-time blinkers last month and now reverts to hurdling; on good mark in this sphere if back on song in refitted cheekpieces, and today's trip/ground ought to suit.

runners.comment: Won by 13l on handicap debut at Wetherby just under a year ago; not seen since
runners.name: Outer Banks
runners.spotlight: Displayed significant improvement on handicap debut at Wetherby (3m, soft; first-time tongue-tie) just under a year ago, where he was left clear at final flight to score by 13l; not seen since but could easily have more to offer if fully tuned up.

runners.comment: Runner-up twice on the AW this winter but might be too high in the weights over hurdles
runners.name: Circuit Breaker
runners.spotlight: Won four-runner Kempton novice (2m5f, good) on last season's hurdling debut but the form looks dubious (leaders went off far too quickly) and he was well beaten in his first two handicap hurdles (2m7f/2m4f); reverts to hurdling after two good AW seconds this winter but still needs to prove he can cope with his current mark.

runners.comment: Off since poor Flat run in October but might have untapped potential as a staying hurdler
runners.name: Campaign Trail
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat stayer (heavy-ground winner) who scored on last season's hurdling debut at Doncaster (2m, good) and was subsequently placed off today's mark in a Warwick handicap (2m3f, good; first-time cheekpieces); absent since running poorly on the Flat in October (wore blinkers) but could plausibly have untapped potential over this new trip.

14:55.race_name: Weatherbys Bloodstock Sales Review Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Yet to hit peak form this season but not beaten far when fourth on last two outings
runners.name: Immortal Fame
runners.spotlight: Won three 2m4f chases last season; not really firing on all cylinders this term but wasn't beaten far when fourth on last two appearances (2m6f/3m) and is edging back down the weights.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Hoguenet
runners.comment: Not very reliable but looked in very good nick at Huntingdon in December
runners.name: Impatient
runners.spotlight: 2-9 over fences; not one to rely upon heavily but looked in very good nick when winning readily at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to soft) in December and today's 7lb higher mark may not be beyond him.

runners.comment: Very useful staying chaser in his prime but regressive and inconsistent now
runners.name: Fortescue
runners.spotlight: Veteran who was a very useful staying chaser in his prime but has regressed and become inconsistent; left behind in home straight at Doncaster (3m, good) five weeks ago and needs headgear switch to perk him up here.

runners.breeder: O Triboire & S C E A Ecurie Des Jap
runners.comment: Struggled in veterans' chase here last month; eased in grade but still has a bit to prove
runners.name: Stratagem
runners.spotlight: Formerly very useful; made just a mildly encouraging seasonal/stable debut in December and struggled in veterans' chase here (2m5f, soft) last month; eased in grade today and may yet come good for Mickey Bowen but has more to prove than some; swaps cheekpieces for first-time visor.

runners.comment: Returned to form with C&D (soft) win from off the pace last month
runners.name: Kayce Dutton
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with C&D (soft) win from off the pace in refitted cheekpieces last month, his second course success; it's hard to predict whether he'll be in the same mood or have the race run to suit again today but he's still unexposed over this sort of trip under rules.

runners.comment: Not the force of old but ran well for a long way in Exeter marathon in December
runners.name: Fuji Flight
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced in recent years and patently not the force of old but ran well for a long way in Exeter marathon (3m6f, soft) in December and competes off another career-low mark here; cheekpieces (worn regularly in France in 2019) are given another go; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Returned from long layoff with big run on New Year's Eve and commands respect
runners.name: Smurfette
runners.spotlight: Won two chases in autumn 2024 (2m4f/3m) and returned from long absence with close/clear second of 13 at Uttoxeter (3m, good to soft) on New Year's Eve; has to take a 5lb rise on the chin and prove herself on this right-handed track but still commands respect.

15:30.race_name: Summer Plate Ladies Day 18th July Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Soundly beaten on handicap debut but showed promise beforehand and had wind op afterwards
runners.name: Aim Straight
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on handicap debut five weeks ago but had shown significant promise beforehand and was given a wind op afterwards; remains open to improvement.

runners.comment: Well beaten all four starts for new stable this season but refitted headgear might help
runners.name: Model Approach
runners.spotlight: Made all in two juvenile hurdles for Adrian Keatley in October 2024 (wore blinkers); well beaten all four starts for new stable since October (held up in rear) but has headgear refitted today (cheekpieces) and may benefit from a return to more prominent tactics; interesting.

runners.breeder: Yeomanstown Ls Ltd T Coyle Flaxmanstable
runners.comment: Won juvenile hurdle in summer 2024; back from long layoff with two low-key runs this term
runners.name: Kalkaroo
runners.spotlight: Absent 444 days after winning Fontwell juvenile hurdle (2m1f, good) in summer 2024 and returned with two low-key handicap runs in the autumn; remains lightly raced but needs to get back in the groove.

runners.comment: Maiden winner last April but absent since lesser run later that month; handicap debut
runners.name: Abbey Law
runners.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at second attempt, in Fakenham maiden (2m, good) last April; absent since lesser run later that month (2m5f; treated for post-race ataxia); market may guide before this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Won twice in December; only fifth behind Mr Zee last month but still ran well
runners.name: No Guarantee
runners.spotlight: Struck form with two wins in December (claimer/handicap); managed only fifth in Wincanton race won by Mr Zee last month (1m7f, soft) but still ran well there and can make his presence felt again here.

runners.comment: Unable to land a significant blow in his three qualifying races; handicap debut
runners.name: Thesoldiersminit
runners.spotlight: Unable to land a significant blow in his three qualifying races, albeit not beaten that far when seventh at Southwell (2m, good to soft) in December; improvement possible but needed on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Just 2-18 over hurdles but looked back in prime form when scoring at Wincanton last month
runners.name: Mr Zee
runners.spotlight: Just 2-18 over hurdles but looked back in prime form at Wincanton (1m7f, soft) last month, winning 13-runner handicap by 3l, and a subsequent 5lb rise is not excessive.

runners.comment: Fourth at big odds in new blinkers two starts ago but safely held since; look elsewhere
runners.name: Ramaah
runners.spotlight: Seemed to respond well to first-time blinkers when 100-1 fourth at Ludlow (2m, good) in November but was safely held over 2m3f the following month and is now 0-8 over hurdles; not the percentage call.

16:02.race_name: Market Rasen Racecourse Racing All Year Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Hasn't won since 2023 but can't be dismissed off current mark at this level
runners.name: Chief Black Robe
runners.spotlight: Hasn't tasted success since a four-timer in 2023 but can't be dismissed at this level; drops back to Class 5 off an attractive mark with Fern O'Brien taking off a bonus 5lb.

runners.comment: Won over C&D in October and solid second at Huntingdon most recently; respected
runners.name: Grain Trade
runners.spotlight: Raced mainly on good/good to soft; opened his account in C&D contest in October and would likely have followed up at Fontwell but for a late fall; solid second, behind a subsequent scorer, at Huntingdon (2m) last time; respected.

runners.breeder: S A R L Ecurie Lafeu
runners.comment: Veteran who hasn't won for nearly seven years; opposed
runners.name: Ballywood
runners.spotlight: Veteran who has made the frame twice this term but suffered a heavy defeat on latest start; nearly seven years since his last success; opposed.

runners.comment: May be ready to hit top form, being 3-3 in month of February (all his wins under rules)
runners.name: Everyonesacritic
runners.spotlight: Acts on any ground; not disgraced in December/January races and may be ready to hit top form, being 3-3 in the month of February (all his wins under rules); gained the last win off 1lb higher; this looks the time to catch him.

runners.comment: Scored over C&D on penultimate start (chase debut) and has possibilities back here
runners.name: Florita
runners.spotlight: Failed to show progress at Wetherby on Boxing Day but made a winning chase debut in C&D event (good to soft) earlier in December and may have more to offer back in this scenario; remains of interest at this level.

runners.breeder: J R Hales & Miss L J Hales
runners.comment: Still a maiden but ran well at Market Rasen most recently; may remain competitive
runners.name: Lone Soldier
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden but ran well at Market Rasen (soft; dropped back to 2m1f from 3m) most recently when beaten only 1l by a solid type, pair clear; may remain competitive.

runners.comment: Has a modest strike-rate and recent form isn't particularly convincing
runners.name: Beat The Edge
runners.spotlight: Has a modest strike-rate and balance of recent form doesn't suggests he's about to add to his small tally; current mark reflects where he is at present.
